finance_question.title: Malaysia accident and health has become more sensitive to claims experience
finance_question.text: In the Malaysia segment's sensitivity table, a 10% fall in accident and health claims assumptions moved one year's profit after tax by S$99.3m in 2025, against S$5.9m in 2024. Across life contracts, the loss component on remaining coverage rose from S$727.1m to S$873.9m during 2025. Together these suggest less contractual-service-margin buffer, so claims-cost improvement there may reach profit faster. This is a question for your actuarial team, not a forecast: these are valuation sensitivities of a stock, not an annual saving.
